lines.text: The LORD answers Job out of the whirlwind and asks whether he has an arm like God's.
The LORD points to Behemoth, who feeds on grass like an ox, and says only his Maker can draw the sword against him.
Behemoth lies hidden under the lotus plants in the marsh and stays unafraid even when the Euphrates surges to his mouth.
Leviathan's scales are so tight that no air can pass between them, and his breath sets coals ablaze.
Job says his ears had heard of God, but now his eyes have seen Him, so he repents in sackcloth and ashes.
